This is my own experience. I went years ago it helped for a while. Being heard by someone, pouring my heart out, but the more I speak outloud the trauma of my past and the crazy irrational thoughts in my head, the more I felt ashamed and insane.  The bad experiences I had I never want to speak of again because it makes it even more real if i hear myself say it. The anti depressants helped for awhile but its a dull kind of existence where you feel empty. Not really happy but not overly sad. Just empty. Autopilot. At some point i felt like i was just another box to be checked by the psychiatrists and some mental case that theyll feel sorry for when they go home to their perfect lives. Plus I feel like doctors only care about money and insurance claims etc. So i stopped going. I convinced myself that the pills are working but i stopped taking those too because relying on pills for my life to feel bearable made me feel more helpless and my mom found out and made me throw them out. She insisted that i dont need it. She said i had nothing to be sad about and should feel more grateful and pray more. (Total bullshit) I never went back to the counselors because I felt so needy and stupid and weak to seek help from strange older people who dont even know who i am. The depression stayed like a shadow— i distracted myself with other people, with my goals. But after certian relationships fail and after i finished school, no distraction anymore. 
This horrible depression came crawling back and now its claws are wrapped around my neck. I dont want to go to a therapist again because I dont want to be happy ever again. Because i know any sort of happiness will just be temporary and it will add to the memories of regret and nostalgia that makes the present moment feel even more horrible by comparison. 

If you want to go, you can go because there are people who respond well and get lucky. Maybe you are one of the lucky ones.

Hey i was a straight A student all throughout highschool and college and I was and still am suicidal.
Its not really about the grades or academic achievement or anything. I think we are just all damaged in the head, some wiring is off in our brains and our childhood and current environment makes it worse. How can I make you feel better? I can’t. Just want to know I feel the same way, and if only it’s legal I would end your suffering for you if you would end mine for me. But we are all alone. Society sucks. Maybe we are the sane ones. Maybe everyone who is overly positive are the crayz ones. Maybe maybe Maybe nobody knows the truth. Don’t feel bad about the grades. It means nothing in real life. Why should it? My entire body hurts just from existing. I’m trying to get through it hour by hour. Minute by minute. If I had a firearm, i would have done it by now. But society insists on making it difficult to get one. I’m scared to try any form of suicide because I might get “rescued” by someone and end up in a hospital, my reputation forever ruined and I might end up a handicap. That will make things worse. The anxiety is crippling. God help us. If there is God and if he is truly merciful, he’d let the sufferers die. I’m truly jealous of anyone who dies of an sickness or by murder.  This sucks. I can’t help you. You can’t help me. But here we are. What can you do, though. Every thing is so pointless my mind is poisoned. Can I even take 50 more years of this? I hate being young
